factions.name: North American Peace Corps
factions.motto: Hold the line. Bring them home.
factions.identity: Durable combined arms; reliable frontline vehicles and recovery.
factions.visual: Olive, cream and rescue orange; broad hulls, modular armor, visible crew cabins.
factions.lore: After the Long Blackout, North American evacuation commands became the only institutions able to keep continental supply routes open. Their emergency charter hardened into the North American Peace Corps, a military reconstruction alliance rather than the historical civilian organization. Its elected Assembly promises to reopen the Meridian Network under public supervision. Generals argue that the network must first be secured by force. Communities grateful for restored power increasingly question why temporary military administrations never leave.

factions.name: New European Confederation
factions.identity: Precision, sensor networks and deliberate positional warfare.
factions.visual: Slate blue, white and amber; low profiles, angular turrets, fold-out sensor masts.
factions.lore: The old continental institutions failed when member governments seized their own power reserves. City leagues, surviving national services and industrial cooperatives later negotiated a new confederation with narrow but enforceable obligations. Its armies defend a dense lattice of shared sensors and guaranteed supply routes. The Confederation wants Meridian governed by treaty and transparent technical standards, yet its smaller members fear that the engineers who define those standards will quietly become the new rulers.

factions.name: Order of the Levant and Mediterranean
factions.motto: Keep the wells. Keep the word.
factions.identity: Mobile combined arms, concealment and abundant electrical power.
factions.visual: Ivory, copper and deep teal; heat shields, fabric screens and articulated wheels.
factions.lore: Desalination operators, Levantine municipal councils and Mediterranean convoy leagues created an oath-bound order to defend water and energy infrastructure during the Blackout. Membership is civic and includes many faiths and secular communities. The Order now protects a chain of coastal enclaves rather than a continuous empire. It argues that no distant government should be able to shut off another city's water. Its solar directorates nevertheless want exclusive custody of the very Meridian controls that would make such coercion possible.

factions.name: Democratic Eurasian Federation
factions.motto: A thousand districts. One supply line.
factions.identity: Industrial volume, artillery saturation and replaceable armored forces.
factions.visual: Oxide red, gray and pale yellow; slab armor, exposed running gear and standardized containers.
factions.lore: The Federation emerged from emergency congresses linking surviving Russian regions, Kazakh transport authorities and the northern Korean industrial state. Its charter distributes representation among territorial and workplace assemblies, but wartime production quotas give the central supply ministry enormous power. Some districts defend the federation as their only protection from abandonment; others call its elections ceremonial. It wants Meridian reopened as a shared industrial backbone and is willing to occupy reluctant junction cities to make the plan function.

factions.name: Pacific Dominion
factions.identity: Amphibious maneuver, naval reach and flexible coastal logistics.
factions.visual: Ocean blue, coral orange and white; sealed hulls, folding flight surfaces and deck-mounted drones.
factions.lore: Australia, Indonesian maritime leagues and Japanese industrial authorities kept each other alive through a chain of protected shipping routes. Their emergency maritime command became the Pacific Dominion: a treaty government whose authority is strongest at sea and contested on land. Its admirals want Meridian reopened without allowing a continental power to dictate access to ports. Smaller islands increasingly ask whether the Dominion's promise of open passage includes the right to refuse its bases.

factions.name: Han Empire
factions.motto: A common future requires a common plan.
factions.identity: Affordable infantry, unmanned support and vulnerable command links.
factions.visual: Jade green, crimson and porcelain; compact modular hulls, sensor crowns and standardized drone racks.
factions.lore: A post-Blackout restoration movement recast the surviving Chinese central government as the Han Empire, claiming an old dynastic name for a new administrative order. In this setting the title is political, not a claim that its citizens share one ethnicity. Vietnamese and Cambodian successor governments joined through unequal security and infrastructure treaties, retaining their own armed commands. The imperial court promises to end scarcity by coordinating Meridian centrally; its provincial partners disagree sharply over who gets to write the plan.

factions.name: African Empire
factions.motto: What survives belongs to the future.
factions.identity: Recovery, battlefield salvage and practical industrial endurance.
factions.visual: Ochre, charcoal and bright cyan; repairable panels, reinforced wheels and interchangeable weapon modules.
factions.lore: Nigerian commercial and civic alliances, a Kongo basin compact and southern industrial states built a reconstruction federation around power corridors and mutual investment. Its elected High Steward adopted the title Emperor after mediating a succession of near-civil wars, turning a temporary compromise into a disputed constitutional institution. This Empire claims no automatic authority over all Africa. It wants to own the machinery of recovery rather than purchase access from outsiders, but debates over corridor revenues and the Steward's emergency powers threaten its cohesion.

factions.name: South Asian Protectorate
factions.identity: Protected advances, resilient defenses and battlefield engineering.
factions.visual: Sand, indigo and saffron; layered armor, deployable braces and prominent interception sensors.
factions.lore: After successive grid failures and displacement crises, Indian, Pakistani and Thai successor authorities negotiated a mutual-protection compact for power, food and evacuation routes. Thailand belongs through maritime and infrastructure treaties, not through a claim that it is geographically South Asian. The Protectorate was meant to expire when civilian systems recovered. Its military council now argues that only permanent joint guardianship can prevent another catastrophe, while reformers demand the return of emergency powers to local governments.

unit.han.imperial_guard_tank.role: Better-armored medium tank with an accurate anti-vehicle gun; requires Radar and remains weak against infantry masses.

unit.han.long_command_walker.name: Long Command Walker
unit.han.long_command_walker.role: Heavy crewed command platform. Deploying in 3 seconds extends its command radius by 2 cells but prevents movement.

unit.han.canopy_ranger.name: Canopy Ranger
unit.han.canopy_ranger.role: Rifle infantry camouflaging after 6 seconds stationary without firing on any terrain. Moving, attacking or taking damage reveals it.

unit.han.reed_rocket_skimmer.name: Reed Rocket Skimmer
unit.han.reed_rocket_skimmer.role: Unmanned amphibious light artillery firing short rocket bursts; less range and health than Nest.

unit.han.mekong_field_engineer.name: Mekong Field Engineer
unit.han.mekong_field_engineer.role: Unarmed detector, structure repairer and command provider. Its command field requires a 2-second stationary deployment; service Engineers remain available.

unit.han.lotus_drone_tender.name: Lotus Drone Tender
unit.han.lotus_drone_tender.role: Light transport and detector. Repairs one nearby friendly unmanned land unit at 1% maximum health per second, paying normal repair cost; cannot repair itself.

unit.ae.union_guard.name: Union Guard
unit.ae.union_guard.role: Reliable general infantry protecting repair and salvage teams.

unit.ae.pike_team.name: Pike Team
unit.ae.pike_team.role: Anti-tank infantry with a short-to-medium-range missile.

unit.ae.reclaimer.name: Reclaimer
unit.ae.reclaimer.role: Armed salvage specialist; repairs one land vehicle at normal Engineer rate and gains salvage access.

unit.ae.mamba_apc.name: Mamba APC
unit.ae.mamba_apc.role: Wheeled light transport and detector; strong road mobility.

unit.ae.buffalo_tank.name: Buffalo Tank
unit.ae.buffalo_tank.role: Conventional medium tank designed for repair and reuse.

unit.ae.weaver_aa.name: Weaver AA
unit.ae.weaver_aa.role: Mobile anti-air and detector with poor anti-armor capability.

unit.ae.forge_howitzer.name: Forge Howitzer
unit.ae.forge_howitzer.role: Durable indirect artillery with shorter range than most rivals.

unit.ae.kiln_assault_crawler.name: Kiln Assault Crawler
unit.ae.kiln_assault_crawler.role: Heavy demolition vehicle with a broad blast and short reach.

unit.ae.sunbird_interceptor.name: Sunbird Interceptor
unit.ae.sunbird_interceptor.role: Dedicated fighter protecting advancing ground formations.

unit.ae.hammerhead_gunship.name: Hammerhead Gunship
unit.ae.hammerhead_gunship.role: Close-support anti-vehicle aircraft, vulnerable to prepared AA.

unit.ae.delta_patrol_boat.name: Delta Patrol Boat
unit.ae.delta_patrol_boat.role: River and coastal scout with a light cannon.

unit.ae.sovereign_arsenal_ship.name: Sovereign Arsenal Ship
unit.ae.sovereign_arsenal_ship.role: Heavy naval artillery platform with limited mobility.

unit.ae.civic_rifle_team.name: Civic Rifle Team
unit.ae.civic_rifle_team.role: Rifle infantry able to place one 20-second sensor puck every 30 seconds. Puck reveals a 4-cell area but does not detect camouflage and is destructible.

unit.ae.lagos_drone_guard.name: Lagos Drone Guard
unit.ae.lagos_drone_guard.role: Mobile anti-air and detector with one small repair drone. The drone repairs one nearby infantry unit at 1% maximum health per second and can be shot down.

unit.ae.river_warden.name: River Warden
unit.ae.river_warden.role: Armed repair and salvage infantry. Camouflages after 6 seconds stationary; repairing, salvaging or firing reveals it.

unit.ae.okapi_amphibious_carrier.name: Okapi Amphibious Carrier
unit.ae.okapi_amphibious_carrier.role: Amphibious light transport and detector; thin armor but strong passenger capacity.

unit.ae.rhino_rail_tank.name: Rhino Rail Tank
unit.ae.rhino_rail_tank.role: Accurate anti-armor rail tank with little splash; requires Radar and cannot efficiently clear infantry alone.

unit.ae.protea_gun_carrier.name: Protea Gun Carrier
unit.ae.protea_gun_carrier.role: Switches in 3 seconds between indirect siege shells and short-range defensive canister fire; cannot use both simultaneously.

unit.sap.shield_rifle_squad.name: Shield Rifle Squad
unit.sap.shield_rifle_squad.role: General infantry with good staying power behind cover.

unit.sap.kavach_team.name: Kavach Team
unit.sap.kavach_team.role: Anti-vehicle missile infantry; cannot fire on the move.

unit.sap.combat_pioneer.name: Combat Pioneer
unit.sap.combat_pioneer.role: Armed engineer building temporary cover and repairing defenses; cannot capture structures.

unit.sap.jackal_apc.name: Jackal APC
unit.sap.jackal_apc.role: Light transport and detector with modest armor.

unit.sap.bulwark_tank.name: Bulwark Tank
unit.sap.bulwark_tank.role: Slow medium tank supporting infantry advances.

unit.sap.monsoon_howitzer.name: Monsoon Howitzer
unit.sap.monsoon_howitzer.role: Steady indirect artillery with a 3-second deployment.

unit.sap.elephant_siege_tank.name: Elephant Siege Tank
unit.sap.elephant_siege_tank.role: Heavy assault gun with strong anti-structure damage and slow traverse.

unit.sap.garuda_interceptor.name: Garuda Interceptor
unit.sap.garuda_interceptor.role: Dedicated defensive fighter with good endurance.

unit.sap.sarus_gunship.name: Sarus Gunship
unit.sap.sarus_gunship.role: Close-support anti-vehicle aircraft with a short effective range.

unit.sap.estuary_patrol_boat.name: Estuary Patrol Boat
unit.sap.estuary_patrol_boat.role: River and coastal scout with a light cannon.

unit.sap.citadel_monitor.name: Citadel Monitor
unit.sap.citadel_monitor.role: Armored coastal artillery ship, slow and vulnerable without escorts.

unit.sap.arjun_assault_tank.name: Arjun Assault Tank
unit.sap.arjun_assault_tank.role: Armored medium tank mounting a short-range active-protection system. It intercepts one ordinary missile every 15 seconds; requires Radar.

unit.sap.gaj_siege_platform.name: Gaj Siege Platform
unit.sap.gaj_siege_platform.role: Heavy siege vehicle that deploys in 4 seconds for weapon range +20% and cannot move while deployed.

unit.sap.river_marine.name: River Marine
unit.sap.river_marine.role: Rifle infantry taking 20% less weapon damage for 6 seconds after disembarking. Immediate reboarding cannot refresh the effect.

unit.sap.naga_amphibious_carrier.name: Naga Amphibious Carrier
unit.sap.naga_amphibious_carrier.role: Amphibious light transport and detector with a smoke launcher: one 4-cell-radius, 6-second shared-rule smoke screen every 40 seconds.

unit.sap.watchpost_recon_team.name: Watchpost Recon Team
unit.sap.watchpost_recon_team.role: Detector and artillery observer that camouflages after 6 stationary seconds. Cannot build cover or repair defenses.

unit.sap.shaheen_missile_battery.name: Shaheen Missile Battery
unit.sap.shaheen_missile_battery.role: Precision missile artillery requiring 3 seconds to deploy; long reach, small blast radius and vulnerable during reload.

power.napc.uav_sweep.name: UAV Sweep
power.napc.uav_sweep.text: A shootable reconnaissance UAV circles a 7-cell-radius area for 12 seconds, revealing terrain and detecting concealed units.

power.napc.field_repair_drop.name: Field Repair Drop
power.napc.field_repair_drop.text: A shootable cargo aircraft delivers a repair station. It repairs friendly land vehicles in 5 cells by 2% maximum health per second for 10 seconds; stations do not stack.

power.napc.combined_arms_window.name: Combined Arms Window
power.napc.combined_arms_window.text: For 15 seconds, friendly infantry, land vehicles and aircraft in a selected 6-cell-radius zone deal 10% more weapon damage. Ships and structures receive no bonus.

power.napc.rapid_turnaround.name: Rapid Turnaround
power.napc.rapid_turnaround.text: One powered Airfield rearms aircraft 50% faster for 20 seconds. Does not accelerate aircraft production.

power.napc.floating_workshop.name: Floating Workshop
power.napc.floating_workshop.text: Deploy a visible repair pontoon on clear land or water. For 20 seconds it repairs friendly vehicles and ships within 5 cells at 1.5% maximum health per second.

power.napc.coordinated_advance.name: Coordinated Advance
power.napc.coordinated_advance.text: Friendly infantry in a 6-cell-radius zone gain movement speed +25% and suppression immunity for 12 seconds. Existing suppression is removed.

power.nec.survey_drone.name: Survey Drone
power.nec.survey_drone.text: A shootable drone reveals and detects within 6 cells of the target for 15 seconds.

power.nec.counterbattery_mission.name: Counterbattery Mission
power.nec.counterbattery_mission.text: After 5 seconds of warning, six conventional precision shells strike a selected 4-cell-radius area over 4 seconds. Moderate siege damage; moving units can escape.

power.nec.treaty_coordination.name: Treaty Coordination
power.nec.treaty_coordination.text: For 20 seconds, powered Relays provide damage +15% instead of +10%. No additional benefit outside their fields.

power.nec.silent_watch.name: Silent Watch
power.nec.silent_watch.text: Friendly stationary ground units in a 6-cell-radius area camouflage for up to 15 seconds. Movement, firing or detection breaks concealment.

power.nec.armored_overwatch.name: Armored Overwatch
power.nec.armored_overwatch.text: For 15 seconds, stationary tanks in a selected 6-cell-radius zone gain weapon range +10%. Moving immediately removes the bonus.

power.nec.emergency_earthworks.name: Emergency Earthworks
power.nec.emergency_earthworks.text: Friendly infantry and defenses in a 5-cell-radius zone take 20% less explosive damage for 15 seconds. Does not protect vehicles.

power.olm.dust_screen.name: Dust Screen
power.olm.dust_screen.text: A 6-cell-radius smoke zone lasts 12 seconds. All ground units inside, friendly or enemy, take 30% less direct-fire weapon damage; artillery and area blasts are unaffected.

power.olm.mobile_workshop.name: Mobile Workshop
power.olm.mobile_workshop.text: Place a visible, destructible repair drone station on clear ground. It repairs friendly vehicles in 5 cells at 2% maximum health per second for 15 seconds; no stacking.

power.olm.open_corridor.name: Open Corridor
power.olm.open_corridor.text: Friendly land vehicles in a selected 6-cell-radius zone gain movement speed +25% for 12 seconds. Units must be in the zone when activated.

power.olm.capacitor_discharge.name: Capacitor Discharge
power.olm.capacitor_discharge.text: Thermal-beam units and Sunwall defenses in a 6-cell-radius zone deal damage +20% for 10 seconds, then cannot fire for 4 seconds while cooling.

power.olm.false_convoy.name: False Convoy
power.olm.false_convoy.text: Create four visible decoy light vehicles for 25 seconds at a scouted clear location. They have 1 health, no damage, no collision and no capture ability; detectors identify them.

power.olm.straits_crossfire.name: Straits Crossfire
power.olm.straits_crossfire.text: Friendly infantry and ships in a selected 6-cell-radius zone gain weapon range +10% and sight +20% for 15 seconds.

power.def.mobilization_order.name: Mobilization Order
power.def.mobilization_order.text: For 20 seconds, Barracks and Factory production progresses 25% faster. Costs remain unchanged; benefit applies only while this power is active.

power.def.tremor_barrage.name: Tremor Barrage
power.def.tremor_barrage.text: After a 6-second warning, four waves of conventional shells strike a 5-cell-radius area over 8 seconds. High area pressure, limited precision.

power.def.redundant_orders.name: Redundant Orders
power.def.redundant_orders.text: Friendly vehicles in a 6-cell-radius zone ignore weapon-disabling EMP effects for 10 seconds. Does not protect buildings or prevent damage.

power.def.steel_advance.name: Steel Advance
power.def.steel_advance.text: Land vehicles in a 6-cell-radius zone take 20% less weapon damage for 12 seconds, but movement speed is reduced by a further 20% during the effect.

power.def.transit_priority.name: Transit Priority
power.def.transit_priority.text: Friendly collectors and ground transports in a 7-cell-radius zone gain movement speed +35% for 15 seconds. Does not improve harvesting or unloading rate.

power.def.false_front.name: False Front
power.def.false_front.text: Place a 30-second decoy Radar and three decoy tanks in a scouted 6-cell zone. All are harmless, non-blocking and revealed by detectors.

power.pd.maritime_patrol.name: Maritime Patrol
power.pd.maritime_patrol.text: A shootable patrol aircraft reveals and detects a 20-cell-long, 6-cell-wide corridor for 12 seconds. Works over land and water.

power.pd.expeditionary_workshop.name: Expeditionary Workshop
power.pd.expeditionary_workshop.text: A shootable aircraft drops a 20-second workshop on clear land or water, repairing friendly vehicles and ships in 5 cells at 1.5% maximum health per second.

power.pd.joint_landing.name: Joint Landing
power.pd.joint_landing.text: For 15 seconds, friendly ground units that disembark from transports take 20% less weapon damage for 6 seconds. Reboarding cannot refresh an existing protection effect.

power.pd.long_watch.name: Long Watch
power.pd.long_watch.text: Reveal a 7-cell-radius area for 18 seconds through a high-altitude sensor pass. It reveals terrain and ordinary units but does not detect camouflage.

power.pd.feint_landing.name: Feint Landing
power.pd.feint_landing.text: Create three harmless, non-blocking decoy transports for 25 seconds on scouted land or water. They cannot carry units and are identified by detectors.

power.pd.precision_window.name: Precision Window
power.pd.precision_window.text: Friendly aircraft and ships in a 6-cell-radius zone gain weapon damage +20% for 10 seconds, but receive no bonus to sight or survivability.

power.han.wideband_scan.name: Wideband Scan
power.han.wideband_scan.text: Reveal and detect a 7-cell-radius area for 6 seconds. A visible scan warning gives opponents 2 seconds before detection begins.

power.han.software_surge.name: Software Surge
power.han.software_surge.text: Friendly unmanned combat units in a 6-cell-radius zone gain reload interval -25% for 12 seconds, then lose weapons for 3 seconds. Excludes superweapon summons.

power.han.reserve_bandwidth.name: Reserve Bandwidth
power.han.reserve_bandwidth.text: For 20 seconds, all surviving command-field providers gain radius +3 cells. Damage bonus stays at +10% and overlapping fields still do not stack.

power.han.central_priority.name: Central Priority
power.han.central_priority.text: For 15 seconds, command fields provide weapon damage +20% instead of +10%; their radius is unchanged.

power.han.broken_contact.name: Broken Contact
power.han.broken_contact.text: Ground combat units in a 6-cell-radius zone gain movement speed +20% for 10 seconds and leave a 6-second smoke screen at their initial position. Smoke follows the shared Dust Screen rule.

power.han.repair_swarm.name: Repair Swarm
power.han.repair_swarm.text: Repair friendly unmanned land units and structures in a 5-cell-radius zone by 2% maximum health per second for 10 seconds. This paid power has no further repair charge.

power.ae.survey_network.name: Survey Network
power.ae.survey_network.text: Reveal a 7-cell-radius area for 12 seconds and highlight salvageable wrecks there. Reveals ordinary units but does not detect camouflage.

power.ae.field_refurbishment.name: Field Refurbishment
power.ae.field_refurbishment.text: Repair friendly land vehicles in a 6-cell-radius zone by 3% maximum health per second for 10 seconds. They cannot fire while receiving repairs; moving ends repair on that unit.

power.ae.recovery_priority.name: Recovery Priority
power.ae.recovery_priority.text: For 20 seconds, Engineers and Reclaimers gain movement speed +25% and salvage in 3 seconds. Salvage payout is unchanged.

power.ae.civil_defense_net.name: Civil Defense Net
power.ae.civil_defense_net.text: Friendly infantry in a 6-cell-radius area gain sight +25% and suppression immunity for 15 seconds.

power.ae.concealed_crossing.name: Concealed Crossing
power.ae.concealed_crossing.text: Lay a 16-cell-long, 4-cell-wide smoke corridor on land or water for 12 seconds. It follows the shared Dust Screen damage rule and protects either side.

power.ae.counterbattery_solution.name: Counterbattery Solution
power.ae.counterbattery_solution.text: Reveal enemy artillery that fired during the preceding 8 seconds within a selected 9-cell area, then mark those units for 12 seconds. Friendly ground weapons deal +15% damage to marked targets.

power.sap.recon_balloon.name: Recon Balloon
power.sap.recon_balloon.text: Deploy a shootable tethered observation drone at a clear location for 20 seconds. It reveals terrain and detects within 6 cells.

power.sap.emergency_fortification.name: Emergency Fortification
power.sap.emergency_fortification.text: Friendly defenses and production buildings in a 6-cell-radius zone take 25% less weapon damage for 15 seconds. Does not protect the superweapon structure or prevent EMP.

power.sap.protected_advance.name: Protected Advance
power.sap.protected_advance.text: For 12 seconds, infantry and land vehicles in a selected 6-cell-radius zone take 15% less weapon damage. Units receive no movement bonus.

power.sap.assault_coordination.name: Assault Coordination
power.sap.assault_coordination.text: Friendly tanks in a 6-cell-radius zone gain reload interval -15% and sight +15% for 12 seconds.

power.sap.mobile_reserve.name: Mobile Reserve
power.sap.mobile_reserve.text: Friendly ground transports in a 7-cell-radius zone gain movement speed +30% for 15 seconds and may unload while moving at half speed.

power.sap.counterlaunch_plot.name: Counterlaunch Plot
power.sap.counterlaunch_plot.text: Mark enemy artillery that fired in the last 8 seconds inside a selected 8-cell-radius zone. After a 5-second warning, conventional shells hit the marked positions, not the units' new locations.
